def _direction_report(items, boot, direction):
    long_items = [item for item in items
                  if item.get("boot") == boot and item.get("direction") == direction
                  and item.get("phase") == "long"]
    valid_ids = [item.get("id") for item in long_items
                 if item.get("status") == "ok" and item.get("metrics")]
    invalid_ids = sorted(item.get("id") for item in long_items
                         if item.get("status") != "ok" or not item.get("metrics"))
    complete = (len(long_items) == EXPECTED_DIRECTION_LONG
                and len(valid_ids) == EXPECTED_DIRECTION_LONG)
    by_key = _comparison_items(items, boot, direction)
    comparisons = []
    for baseline in COMPARISON_TAGS:
        entry = results2._compare_pair(by_key, "long", ACTUAL_TAG, baseline,
                                       TARGET, 8, direction, None)
        if entry is None:
            comparisons.append({
                "baseline": baseline,
                "status": "missing",
                "protection_matched": False,
                "a_gain_fraction": None,
                "paired_rounds": 0,
            })
            continue
        entry = dict(entry)
        entry["status"] = "present"
        entry["boot"] = boot
        entry["direction"] = direction
        comparisons.append(entry)
    a_means = {baseline: _baseline_a_mean(items, boot, direction, baseline)
               for baseline in BASELINE_CANDIDATES}
    strong = _pick_strong_baseline(comparisons, a_means)
    gain = strong.get("a_gain_fraction") if strong else None
    gain_is_number = isinstance(gain, (int, float)) and not isinstance(gain, bool)
    all_pairs_complete = all(

        reason = ("no p1..p4 baseline satisfies the pre-registered protection match: "
                  "evidence insufficient")

class StrongBaselineTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @staticmethod
    def _item(method, boot, round_index, v, a, direction=0):
        return {
            "id": "%s-b%d-r%d" % (method, boot, round_index),
            "status": "ok",
            "phase": "long",
            "method": method,
            "target": 170,
            "boot": boot,
            "round": round_index,
            "direction": direction,
            "a_pages": 8,
            "reverse": direction,
            "metrics": {"v_mib_s": v, "a_mib_s": a,
                        "policy": {"counters": {"complete_active_windows": 5,
                                                "short_windows": 0}}},
        }

    def _full_sample(self, a_values, v=172.0, direction=0, boot=1):
        items = []
        for round_index in (1, 2, 3):
            for method in method88.METHODS:
                items.append(self._item(method, boot, round_index, v,
                                        a_values.get(method, 100.0), direction))
        return items

    def test_best_feasible_baseline_is_the_highest_a_match(self):
        items = self._full_sample({"p5": 30.0, "p1": 10.0, "p2": 15.0,
                                   "p3": 20.0, "p4": 5.0})
        entry = method88._direction_report(items, 1, 0)
        self.assertTrue(entry["complete"])
        self.assertEqual(entry["strong_baseline"], "p3")
        self.assertTrue(entry["pass"])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(entry["strong_baseline_gain"], 0.05)

    def test_no_matched_baseline_is_evidence_insufficient(self):
        items = self._full_sample({"p5": 30.0, "p1": 10.0, "p2": 10.0,
                                   "p3": 10.0, "p4": 10.0})
        for item in items:
            if item["method"] in method88.BASELINE_CANDIDATES:
                item["metrics"]["v_mib_s"] = 200.0
        entry = method88._direction_report(items, 1, 0)
        self.assertIsNone(entry["strong_baseline"])
        self.assertFalse(entry["pass"])
        self.assertIn("insufficient", entry["reason"])

    def test_below_threshold_gain_does_not_pass(self):
        items = self._full_sample({"p5": 10.2, "p1": 9.0, "p2": 8.0,
                                   "p3": 7.0, "p4": 10.0})
        entry = method88._direction_report(items, 1, 0)
        self.assertEqual(entry["strong_baseline"], "p4")
        self.assertFalse(entry["pass"])

    def test_incomplete_sample_never_passes(self):
        items = [self._item("p5", 1, r, 172.0, 30.0) for r in (1, 2, 3)]
        items += [self._item("p3", 1, r, 172.0, 10.0) for r in (1, 2, 3)]
        entry = method88._direction_report(items, 1, 0)
        self.assertFalse(entry["complete"])
        self.assertFalse(entry["pass"])
        self.assertIn("incomplete", entry["reason"])
